newsitem.title: USA: Avitar gets FDA approval to market drug.
newsitem.headline: Avitar gets FDA approval to market drug.

text.p: Avitar Inc said Tuesday it had received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to market a urine test for abuse of methamphetamine.
The company said in a statement the Visualine II test will become part of its line of the major drugs of abuse tests.
Other tests distributed by Avitar and produced by its associate, Sun Biomedical Laboratories, include some for opiates, cocaine, and benzodiazepine.

"Not only does this clearance to market give us a full line of major drugs of abuse tests for the diagnostic market but it also aids the development of our saliva based drugs of abuse tests," it said.
Avitar said it and Sun Biomedical Laboratories were developing saliva tests for drug abuse that will be derived from the urine tests.
